Name: The Warden
CharacterDescription: The Warden of the West and Lord of Casterly Rock. Tywin served as Hand of the King of Aerys II Targaryen, his friend for many years until he went mad. Tywin is one of the most powerful men in the Seven Kingdoms and some say even more powerful than the King himself. Brutal, efficient, and callus Tywin is a man that achieves his goals no matter the cost. He has recently taken command of the army of the Crownlands and Westerlands to do battle against the Starks and their bannermen, although he has been suffering unexpected defeats as of late, Tywin's cunning is not to be trifled with.
